_comment: Example config for scripts/splunk_poll.py. Copy to a local file (e.g. config/splunk-poll.json) and edit. Credentials are NOT stored here: set SPLUNK_USERNAME and SPLUNK_PASSWORD in the environment before running with --execute.
_comment_splunk_url: Exact IPv4 management URL (port 8089). The Splunk server is 172.20.240.20 in this lab. https only; no credentials, no hostnames.
_comment_index: Where team_security events land. Confirm the actual index name with your Splunk admin before use.
_comment_queries: Detection leads, not confirmed findings. Keep each query small and scoped to the index. Adjust field names (uri, process, parent_process, dst_ip, dst_port) to match your actual event schema after a quick `| head` sanity check.

queries.query: index=team_security earliest=-5m latest=now ("eval(" OR "base64_decode" OR "system(" OR "cmd.exe /c") | table _time, host, uri, src_ip | head 100

index=team_security earliest=-5m latest=now parent_process="w3wp.exe" (process="cmd.exe" OR process="powershell.exe" OR process="whoami.exe" OR process="certutil.exe") | table _time, host, process, command_line | head 100

index=team_security earliest=-5m latest=now (process="powershell.exe" AND (command_line="*-enc*" OR command_line="*FromBase64String*" OR command_line="*IEX*" OR command_line="*DownloadString*")) | table _time, host, command_line | head 100

index=team_security earliest=-5m latest=now eventtype=outbound (dst_port!=443 AND dst_port!=80) src_ip="172.20.240.*" | stats min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, count by dst_ip, dst_port, process | head 100

index=team_security earliest=-5m latest=now (user_agent="*sqlmap*" OR user_agent="*nmap*" OR user_agent="*nikto*" OR user_agent="*masscan*" OR user_agent="*dirbuster*") | table _time, src_ip, uri, user_agent | head 100
